label: Box K node from the GOD_NAMING_2 node through rigid designation
meaning: If some actual root n is GOD_4, the one GOD_4, with the classical attributes, and the name 'God', whose bearer is fixed at w as the unique existing GOD_4, designates something at every accessible world, then n exists at every accessible world. The name is rigid for n (it designates n exactly where n exists), so by the rigid-designation library its strict necessary co-designation is equivalent to n's necessary existence. The premise is logically equivalent to the conclusion (rigidIffBoxK): this argument identifies the box K node as the rigid-name reading of 'God exists necessarily' and adds no independent warrant for it.
